title: Deputy Shoots Armed Walmart Theft Suspect After Taser Fails
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Orlando, Florida — On February 22, 2026, at approximately 8:30 pm, Orange County Deputies responded to a call at the Walmart at 11250 East Colonial Drive about a man who was stealing a shopping cart full of items and appeared to have a knife. A deputy encountered the man on Colonial Drive near the Walmart and gave the man several commands to stop, but he refused to comply. The deputy then used his taser, but it didn’t have any effect on the man. Shortly after that our deputy can be heard telling the suspect at least three times “don’t reach” and after those commands, the deputy discharged his service weapon, striking the man. He was taken to the hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Two knives were recovered at the scene. The suspect has been identified as 48-year-old Jason Anthony Beal. He has been charged with robbery with a deadly weapon and resisting an officer with violence.
